scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w client
